en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing an intersection in an old European city. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along cobbled streets between multi‑story stone buildings. There is a bridge or canal railing with ornate street lamps on the right, and a gabled building with the sign 'APTEK' (pharmacy). Printed caption text appears along the bottom margin identifying the street corner and the city.
